## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or milestone.

## Validation

List checks performed and any meaningful checks you could not run. Include screenshots
for visual changes and reviewed hardware evidence when relevant.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The target follows feature → develop → staging → main without skipping stages.
- [ ] The change is focused and follows CONTRIBUTING.md and the Code of Conduct.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are included.
- [ ] No credentials, model weights, private data, or generated build artifacts are included.
- [ ] Runtime ownership, privacy, and accessibility requirements are preserved.
- [ ] Commits have meaningful subjects and no co-author trailers or generated attribution.
